name: glare-hover
title: Glare Hover
description: A wrapper that lays a wide diagonal light band over any card; on hover the band slides across the surface, lighting it up in a chosen colour and fading away on leave.
use: Static metric or feature cards need a small reward when the pointer passes over them.
avoid: Touch devices: the glare only appears on hover and never shows on tap.
a11y: The glare is hover-only on a plain div, so keyboard and touch users never see it. (keyboard: no, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two dark metric cards with thin rounded borders side by side, each showing a small uppercase label, a large number and a green percentage line. On hover one card is crossed by a broad angled band of colour.
behaves: The pointer entering slides a translucent diagonal gradient from the top-left corner to the bottom-right over about half a second; leaving reverses it out of view.
customise: Size, background, glare colour, opacity, angle, band width, duration and a play-once flag are all props; the layout inside is your own children.
weight: light: One pseudo-element with a background-position transition; idle until hover.
demo: Two metric cards: "Total Revenue $48,295 +12.4%" and "Active Users 3,842 +8.1%".
polishWhy: The sweep is smooth and the colour reads well, but it is a plain stat card underneath.
